svg.title: FireSat report authenticity
svg.desc: GSN v3 core notation. Structural validity does not establish evidence sufficiency or approval.

g.title: A1 · Assumption: The retired development downlink interface is absent from the reviewed operational configuration.
C1 · Context: Fire Detection Payload; Standby and Imaging; cryogenic sensor operation on a thermally stable platform.
C2 · Context: Loss: authentic fire reports. Asset: fire detection reports. Mission Critical; Authenticity. Prototype illustration.
C3 · Context: Acceptance criteria, operational evidence and authority decisions remain outstanding; no operational approval is asserted.
C4 · Context: The source marks one frame-injection route Complete Block; effectiveness has not been demonstrated.
G1 · Goal: Loss of authentic fire reports is acceptably controlled in the declared Fire Detection Payload configuration.
G2 · Goal: The selected Loss, payload scope and modeled routes are traceable to the recorded prototype baseline.
G3 · Goal: Firmware, diagnostic access and update-key custody preserve authentic report generation. · Undeveloped
G4 · Goal: Sensor-frame origin and integrity are established before data enters the classification chain. · Undeveloped
G5 · Goal: Detection classification and calibration references preserve authentic fire-report content. · Undeveloped
G6 · Goal: Report freshness is maintained through replay attempts, counter rollover and state transitions. · Undeveloped
G7 · Goal: Residual, blocked, derived and excluded routes have sufficient justification for acceptance.
G8 · Goal: Prototype route dispositions and rationale are recorded for independent scrutiny.
G9 · Goal: The regime authority accepts residual exposure against approved criteria and verified evidence. · Undeveloped
J1 · Justification: Processor, sensor, classification and downlink branches follow the four attack surfaces in the Loss Tool.
S1 · Strategy: Argue over scope, four report-chain attack surfaces and the justification of residual decisions.
Sn1 · Solution: Recorded Loss scope and route inventory; supports traceability only.
Sn2 · Solution: Recorded prototype dispositions; documents decisions without validating them.
